beaches.name: Arkoudilas (Αρκουδίλας)
beaches.summary: A 2018 naturist report describes a couple of nude bathers at the right-hand side. The directory entry says the beach is mostly clothed; two beach guides tag it naturist without any reports. No signage or designation found, and the source itself warns that past naturist use may not continue.

beaches.name: Issos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported beyond the windsurf station, towards the Korission dunes. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2010 to 2019 describing the far stretch as predominantly nude, with no signs marking the area. The dunes are part of the protected Lake Korission area; no designation is documented.
